synopsis: Star Wars Manga: Silver is a manga one-shot published by Tokyopop in the vein of Star Wars Tales. It is the second issue, preceeded by Star Wars Manga: Black. It was published in both Japan and the United Kingdom, not the United States. Author Daniel Wallace stated definitively that the stories included in the Star Wars Manga: Silver comic trade paperback are non-canon
title: Star Wars Manga: Silver
